newsitem.title: UK: UK wheat and barley futures close sharply lower.
newsitem.headline: UK wheat and barley futures close sharply lower.

text.p: UK grain futures closed sharply lower on Friday with values under pressure from all sides.

Traders said a strong local currency had combined with reports of a higher French crop than originally forecast, a bearish USDA crop report and disappointment at the result of Thursday's weekly EU grain tender.
"Where ever you look today there has been bearish news," said a trader.
Wheat futures closed with falls of between 2.45 and 1.75 stg while barley was 1.25 to 1.60 stg down.
Turnovers were 550 lots for wheat and 87 lots for barley.
In Amsterdam the milling wheat futures contract closed four marks down after trading nine lots all in December 1996.
On the UK cash markets feed wheat traded at 105 stg for Nov and 107 stg for Feb fob east coast ports with sellers over.
In the delivered sector trades reported little activity with most buyers waiting for the futures market to settle before committing themselves.
"Buyers are very wary at the moment they have been caught by falling markets too often recently," said a trader.
